d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
q: A background in retail, e-commerce, or FMCG with direct responsibility for warehousing and distribution.
10–15 years of experience in e-commerce warehousing and last-mile operations, with hands-on experience managing both.
Experience in organizations with mature processes, standards and SOPs.
A track record of tangible achievements.
A degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Management or a related field.
Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS), order management systems (OMS) and fleet management systems.
Strong Excel, Looker and BI dashboards abilities.
Strong in data analytics, project planning and coordination, and critical thinking

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.
r: As Director – E-Commerce Fulfilment, you will lead our fulfilment and last-mile operations in KSA, reporting to the VP of E-Commerce Fulfilment. You will own the end-to-end physical customer journey, from picking, packing and dispatch through to delivery and returns, across a multi-site network of warehouses and micro-fulfilment centers. You will also partner closely with our Digital & Tech teams on the systems that power it, setting the standard for speed, accuracy and customer experience while building a strong, hands-on team culture. You will:
Lead fulfilment operations across our warehouses and micro-fulfilment centers, ensuring SLA compliance, productivity, scalability and inventory accuracy.
Lead last-mile delivery and returns, driving on-time delivery, quality and cost efficiency, and expanding premium/VIP services.
Partner with Digital & Tech teams on the end-to-end order lifecycle, system integrations and data flows, aligned with the Group OMS roadmap.
Co-create and execute the operational strategy with the VP of E-Commerce Fulfilment to accelerate growth and elevate the customer experience.
Own planning and execution for peak periods such as Ramadan, Cyber Week and Super Sale.
Drive process optimization, automation and the adoption of advanced fulfilment and last-mile solutions, and champion ESG and compliance initiatives.
Define the vendor strategy, lead negotiations with key vendors and 3PLs, and oversee their performance governance.
Work with customer care teams to resolve escalations, reduce “where is my order” contacts, and feed customer insights into operational improvements.
Manage budgets and cost per order and return, and use KPIs to guide tactical and strategic decisions.
Build, mentor and engage a team of senior managers and a large operational workforce, and support network expansion while ensuring business continuity.

d: Grand Hyatt Doha is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support the hotel's marketing, branding, and communication initiatives. The role is responsible for designing high-quality visual content that enhances brand awareness, promotes hotel offerings, and ensures consistency with Hyatt brand standards across all digital and printed materials.
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Multimedia Design, Fine Arts, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum 1-2 years of experience in graphic design, preferably within hospitality, luxury brands, advertising agencies, or related industries.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Basic knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva, or other video editing and content creation tools is an advantage.
Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, branding, digital content, and print design capabilities.
Familiarity with social media content creation and digital marketing principles.
Excellent attention to detail, typography, color theory, and layout design.
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
r: Design and produce marketing collateral including brochures, flyers, posters, menus, banners, advertisements, and promotional materials.
Create engaging visual content for social media platforms, digital campaigns, email marketing, and website updates.
Develop creative concepts and layouts that effectively communicate the hotel's brand identity and campaign objectives.
Support the creation of graphics for hotel events, seasonal promotions, restaurant campaigns, spa offers, and internal initiatives.
Collaborate closely with the Marketing & Communications team and operational departments to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.
Coordinate and edit photography and visual assets for marketing use.
Assist in the production of multimedia content, including basic video editing, motion graphics, and digital animations when required.
Ensure all design work adheres to Hyatt brand guidelines and maintains a consistent brand image.
Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality standards.
Maintain and organize design files, brand assets, and marketing materials.
Stay updated on industry trends, design techniques, and emerging digital platforms to bring fresh ideas to the team.

d: Sanad Edu is a Kuwait-based education consultancy founded by graduates with firsthand experience studying at leading international universities. We support students throughout their study abroad journey by providing comprehensive services, including university admissions, accommodation, visa guidance, student support, and educational opportunities.

Sanad Edu is more than an education consultancy; it is a growing brand and student community focused on creating opportunities, building international partnerships, and delivering engaging experiences through events, exhibitions, campaigns, and student initiatives.
q: Fluent in Arabic (written and spoken), with excellent communication skills.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing and social media platforms.
Creative mindset with the ability to develop new marketing ideas and campaigns.
Interest and practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and AI-powered marketing tools.
Experience in content creation, campaign management, and brand development.
Strong organizational, communication, and project management skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
Experience in event marketing, exhibitions, or partnership management is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
We are looking for someone who is creative, proactive, technology-driven, and ready to take ownership of the marketing direction of a growing brand.
r: We are looking for a creative, ambitious, and forward-thinking Marketing Officer to take responsibility for the overall marketing activities of Sanad Edu and its various business channels.

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait City. The position involves managing and developing multiple social media accounts, planning marketing strategies, creating engaging content, and overseeing digital campaigns across different platforms.

The successful candidate will play an important role in developing Sanad Edu’s brand identity, promoting its services, organizing and marketing events and educational exhibitions, building partnerships, and engaging with students, universities, and international partners.

We are particularly interested in someone who understands the latest digital marketing trends, is enthusiastic about Artificial Intelligence (AI), and can use AI-powered tools to improve content creation, marketing performance, automation, and overall business growth.
Manage and develop Sanad Edu’s overall marketing strategy and activities.
Oversee multiple social media accounts and digital platforms.
Plan, create, and execute marketing campaigns across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other platforms.
Develop creative content, promotional materials, and marketing strategies.
Lead the marketing and promotion of exhibitions, educational events, university visits, and student activities.
Coordinate with universities, educational partners, influencers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct market research and identify new marketing opportunities.
Develop innovative ideas to increase brand awareness, engagement, and lead generation.
Utilize AI tools and emerging technologies to improve marketing operations and productivity.
Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, and continuously improve marketing strategies.
Work closely with the admissions, counseling, housing, and management teams to ensure consistent brand communication.

d: We are looking for a qualified and experienced Structural Engineer to join our construction team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for structural design, technical coordination, site supervision, and ensuring projects meet quality and safety standards.
Prepare and review structural designs, drawings, and calculations.
Supervise construction activities and ensure compliance with approved plans and specifications.
Review structural drawings, shop drawings, and technical documentation.
Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, and consultants.
Monitor project progress, timelines, and construction quality.
Review material specifications and Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
Identify structural issues and provide effective engineering solutions.
Conduct site inspections and prepare technical reports.
Ensure compliance with relevant building codes and safety regulations.
Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
3–5 years of relevant experience in structural engineering.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, ETABS, SAFE, and SAP2000.
Strong knowledge of structural design, construction methods, and building codes.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
Previous experience in Kuwait's construction industry is preferred.
Must be currently based in Kuwait.
